info.title: ADL Observatory API
info.summary: Live runtime state for Observatory clients
info.description: Read current runtime state without login. Login is required to submit bounded conversation intents, signed control commands, or ACIP work over the full-duplex WebSocket.

publicBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the runtime instance.

tags.name: observatory
tags.description: Public Observatory snapshots and live updates with authenticated writes.

get.summary: Read one policy-filtered local Runtime roster page

400.description: Invalid, stale, cross-policy, or tampered roster query.

post.summary: Verify and durably admit an Ollama-backed agent without restart

200.description: Agent admitted or identical declaration already present.

401.description: Missing or invalid Runtime write credential.

409.description: The agent id is already bound to another declaration.

422.description: Invalid declaration or requested model is not installed.

503.description: Provider verification or durable persistence is unavailable.

get.summary: Read one policy-filtered agent detail projection

404.description: Agent is absent or not visible under Runtime policy.

Freeze an agent into a portable bundle without removing the source

get.summary: Read the current Runtime v3 Observatory snapshot

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Select the exact feed projection. Omission preserves the existing v2 contract; v3 opts into Polis identity.

200.description: Negotiated Observatory snapshot; defaults to the existing v2 projection.

get.summary: Open a public-read, authenticated-write Observatory WSS session

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Select the exact public feed frame projection. Omission preserves v2; v3 opts into Polis identity.

get.description: Upgrades to WebSocket after origin validation and immediately emits public ObservatoryFeed frames. A client may log in at any time with an ObservatoryWsAuth text frame. Only an authenticated session may submit signed text commands, bounded conversation intents or cancellations, or bounded ACIP Protobuf binary envelopes. Conversation acceptance and terminal outcomes are Runtime-authoritative and correlated by conversation, turn, recipient, and correlation identifiers.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade accepted after origin validation. Public feed frames begin immediately; frame-level login is required only for writes.

AcipWriteBearer.description: Runtime ACIP write token loaded from the sealed init credential path.

OriginForbidden.description: Origin is absent for WSS or not present in configured observatory.allowed_origins.

UnsupportedObservatorySchema.description: The schema query is not one of v1, v2, or v3.

total_count.description: Number of policy-visible agents in the current local Runtime scope; this is not a global Polis count.

event_cursor.description: Runtime-authenticated revision, policy, and query cursor for the next first-page update.

population_complete.description: False until a separately governed distributed projection can prove global completeness.

name.description: Canonical two-part neutral agent name; segments may not end in a hyphen.

role.description: Legacy persisted declaration field; new admissions use office.

x-adl-non-claims: The HTML Observatory app is not embedded in the runtime.
Observatory WSS mutations require the same signed control-command envelope as /v1/control.
No unavailable feature is presented as operational.
